notes.title: Backyard Football '99 Patch Update 🚨
notes.content: [h3]Hi-ho, Sports fans! 🏈[/h3][p][/p][p]The Backyard Football '99 1.0.5 patch notes are here to deliver smoother and more stable gameplay. We've been at work on crushing all the bugs and improving the game, and here's a list of what's new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]🏈 Updated logos[/b][/p][list][*][p]Felines[/p][/*][*][p]Bulldozers[/p][/*][*][p]Geckos[/p][/*][*][p]Cheetahs[/p][/*][*][p]Ostriches[/p][/*][*][p]Crabs[/p][/*][*][p]Pickles[/p][/*][*][p]Buffalos[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🏈 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]We fixed a bug where a game is marked as an L on the schedule page when the player achieves a 3-digit point.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players can't switch directly between weather options when returning from the team bench.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We're committed to making Backyard Football '99 the best it can be! If you encounter any new bugs after the patch, please keep sending them our way. Your feedback is crucial![/p][p][/p][p]How to Report Bugs: [/p][p]👉🏻 [url="https://bit.ly/BYF99RF"]Bug Report Form[/url][/p][p]✉️ [url="https://Support@megacatstudios.com"]Support@megacatstudios.com[/url][/p][p]💬 Join us on [url="https://discord.gg/TA8czEQpBj"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🏈 Backyard Football ’99 – Out Now! 🏈
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246358/76d9072514e0b1a768c8db70233d5993771f8ee7.png"][/img][/p][p]The classic is back! [b]Backyard Football 1999[/b] has been enhanced to run on modern systems, so you can dive back into the neighborhood gridiron like it’s 1999 all over again. And for this week only, it's 10% off on Steam![/p][p]Whether you’re drafting [b]Jerry Rice[/b] or [b]Barry Sanders[/b] for your dream team, rushing with [b]Pete Wheeler[/b], scoring touchdowns with [b]Pablo Sanchez[/b], or laughing along with the witty banter of [b]Sunny Day[/b] and [b]Chuck Downfield[/b], this is the football game anyone can pick up and play.[/p][h3]Why You’ll Love It[/h3][list][*][p][b]Simple, nostalgic gameplay[/b] – Easy controls mean everyone can join in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All-star roster[/b] – Pick from legendary pros and iconic Backyard Kids.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Classic commentary[/b] – Sunny and Chuck bring every game to life.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Modern compatibility[/b] – Runs smoothly on today’s PCs and mobile devices.[/p][/*][/list][p]Grab your helmet, lace up your cleats, and relive the glory days of backyard football.[/p][p][b]Play now and build your ultimate team![/b] 🏆[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170570/Backyard_Football_99/" style="button" buttoncolor="#30b300"]Steam[/url][/p][p][url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/backyard-football-99/id6740349855" style="button" buttoncolor="#3782fb"]App Store[/url][/p][p][url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pgp.byf99" style="button" buttoncolor="#6b37fb"]Google Play[/url][/p]
